Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
11:08 AM

For programming at ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/Ultra 5 chip. That runs editors, browsers, Docker and several projects at once without slowing down.

RAM: 16 GB is the floor. Pick a laptop where you can add more later.
Screen and keyboard: a Full HD IPS screen, 14 to 15.6 inches, and a keyboard you like typing on. You will use these the most.
Battery and weight: 8+ hours and under 1.8 kg if you carry it daily.
Graphics card: only needed for machine learning or game development. For web, apps and general coding, skip it and spend on RAM and screen quality.

I have not looked at live prices, so I can't name specific laptops yet. Tell me what you mostly code, and I can search for current options in your budget.

Find me 5 weekend trek options near Pune with difficulty and cost
11:11 AM

Here are 5 easy treks that work as day trips from Pune:

Sinhagad, 30 km. About 1.5–2 hours up, and the closest of the five. Famous for sunrise.
Lohagad, 65 km. A wide, well-marked trail of about 1.5 hours up. Malavli railway station is close.
Tikona, 60 km. Short but steep near the top, with a 360° view and fewer crowds.
Korigad, 70 km. An easy, wide path with views of Lonavala lake. Good for families.
Rajmachi, 85 km. Two forts on one plateau. It is the farthest, and many people camp overnight, so start early for a day trip.

It is winter now, so trails are dry and the views are clear. Expect crowds through Oct and Nov. If you want a bit more challenge, Visapur is moderate and sits next to Lohagad, so you can do both in one day.

Source: Weekend Wander, dated Sun 31 May 2026.
